The Thags were a well-known class of murderers who infested IndiThey were devout worshippers of Kali, and the murders were done as an act of worship  the property of the murdered persons was the gift of the goddess to her vota- rieTheir expeditions were undertaken after solemn worship of, and consultation with, the goddess, and in any murder her will was rigidly observed. The most unfavourable omen was the prolonged howl of a single jackal.
